Project fintech_core { database_type: 'PostgreSQL' Note: 'Synthetic interconnected fintech schema' }
Table users {
  id bigint [pk]
  email varchar
  phone varchar
  password_hash varchar
  status varchar
  country_code varchar
  created_at timestamp
  updated_at timestamp
}
Table user_profiles {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  first_name varchar
  last_name varchar
  date_of_birth varchar
  occupation varchar
  risk_tier varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table kyc_profiles {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  status varchar
  provider varchar
  external_reference varchar
  verified_at timestamp
  reviewed_at timestamp
}
Table kyc_documents {
  id bigint [pk]
  kyc_id bigint
  document_type varchar
  document_number_hash varchar
  storage_key varchar
  status varchar
  expires_at timestamp
}
Table user_addresses {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  address_type varchar
  line1 varchar
  city varchar
  state varchar
  postal_code varchar
  country_code varchar
}
Table devices {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  device_fingerprint varchar
  platform varchar
  app_version varchar
  trusted boolean
  last_seen_at timestamp
}
Table sessions {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  device_id bigint
  token_hash varchar
  expires_at timestamp
  revoked_at varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table roles {
  id bigint [pk]
  name varchar
  description varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table user_roles {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  role_id bigint
  assigned_at varchar
}
Table accounts {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  account_number varchar
  account_type varchar
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table account_members {
  id bigint [pk]
  account_id bigint
  user_id bigint
  member_role varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table wallets {
  id bigint [pk]
  account_id bigint
  wallet_type varchar
  status varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table wallet_balances {
  id bigint [pk]
  wallet_id bigint
  available decimal
  pending decimal
  ledger decimal
  updated_at timestamp
}
Table currencies {
  id bigint [pk]
  code varchar
  name varchar
  minor_unit varchar
  is_active varchar
}
Table exchange_rates {
  id bigint [pk]
  base_currency_id bigint
  quote_currency_id bigint
  rate decimal
  provider varchar
  observed_at timestamp
}
Table payment_methods {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  method_type varchar
  provider varchar
  token_reference varchar
  status varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table cards {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  account_id bigint
  last4 varchar
  brand varchar
  status varchar
  issued_at timestamp
  expires_at timestamp
}
Table card_transactions {
  id bigint [pk]
  card_id bigint
  merchant_id bigint
  transaction_id bigint
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
  posted_at timestamp
}
Table merchants {
  id bigint [pk]
  legal_name varchar
  display_name varchar
  category_code varchar
  country_code varchar
  status varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table merchant_accounts {
  id bigint [pk]
  merchant_id bigint
  account_id bigint
  settlement_currency_id bigint
  status varchar
}
Table beneficiaries {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  name varchar
  account_number_hash varchar
  bank_code varchar
  country_code varchar
  status varchar
}
Table transfers {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  source_account_id bigint
  beneficiary_id bigint
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
  reference varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table transfer_routes {
  id bigint [pk]
  transfer_id bigint
  rail varchar
  provider varchar
  route_status varchar
  provider_reference varchar
}
Table transactions {
  id bigint [pk]
  account_id bigint
  user_id bigint
  merchant_id bigint
  type varchar
  direction varchar
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
  reference varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table transaction_entries {
  id bigint [pk]
  transaction_id bigint
  ledger_account_id bigint
  entry_type varchar
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  created_at timestamp
}
Table ledger_accounts {
  id bigint [pk]
  account_id bigint
  code varchar
  name varchar
  account_class varchar
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
}
Table ledger_entries {
  id bigint [pk]
  ledger_account_id bigint
  transaction_id bigint
  debit varchar
  credit varchar
  balance_after varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table fees {
  id bigint [pk]
  transaction_id bigint
  fee_rule_id bigint
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
}
Table fee_rules {
  id bigint [pk]
  name varchar
  fee_type varchar
  rate decimal
  flat_amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  active_from timestamp
  active_to timestamp
}
Table refunds {
  id bigint [pk]
  transaction_id bigint
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  reason varchar
  status varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table chargebacks {
  id bigint [pk]
  transaction_id bigint
  card_transaction_id bigint
  reason_code varchar
  amount decimal
  status varchar
  opened_at timestamp
  resolved_at timestamp
}
Table settlements {
  id bigint [pk]
  merchant_id bigint
  settlement_date timestamp
  gross_amount decimal
  fee_amount decimal
  net_amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
}
Table settlement_items {
  id bigint [pk]
  settlement_id bigint
  transaction_id bigint
  gross_amount decimal
  fee_amount decimal
  net_amount decimal
}
Table invoices {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  merchant_id bigint
  invoice_number varchar
  subtotal decimal
  tax decimal
  total decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
  due_at timestamp
}
Table invoice_items {
  id bigint [pk]
  invoice_id bigint
  description varchar
  quantity varchar
  unit_price decimal
  line_total decimal
}
Table subscriptions {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  merchant_id bigint
  plan_code varchar
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  status varchar
  started_at timestamp
  next_billing_at timestamp
}
Table subscription_events {
  id bigint [pk]
  subscription_id bigint
  event_type varchar
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  occurred_at timestamp
}
Table loans {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  principal decimal
  currency_id bigint
  interest_rate decimal
  term_months varchar
  status varchar
  originated_at timestamp
}
Table loan_applications {
  id bigint [pk]
  loan_id bigint
  user_id bigint
  requested_amount decimal
  employment_status varchar
  decision varchar
  submitted_at timestamp
}
Table loan_repayments {
  id bigint [pk]
  loan_id bigint
  schedule_id bigint
  amount decimal
  principal_amount decimal
  interest_amount decimal
  paid_at timestamp
  status varchar
}
Table loan_schedules {
  id bigint [pk]
  loan_id bigint
  installment_number varchar
  due_date timestamp
  principal_due decimal
  interest_due decimal
  status varchar
}
Table credit_scores {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  score decimal
  provider varchar
  score_band varchar
  calculated_at timestamp
}
Table limits {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  account_id bigint
  limit_type varchar
  amount decimal
  currency_id bigint
  period varchar
  active boolean
}
Table limit_events {
  id bigint [pk]
  limit_id bigint
  transaction_id bigint
  previous_used decimal
  new_used decimal
  created_at timestamp
}
Table fraud_cases {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  transaction_id bigint
  risk_score varchar
  case_status varchar
  reason varchar
  opened_at timestamp
  closed_at timestamp
}
Table fraud_events {
  id bigint [pk]
  case_id bigint
  event_type varchar
  signal varchar
  score decimal
  metadata json
  created_at timestamp
}
Table risk_rules {
  id bigint [pk]
  name varchar
  rule_expression varchar
  severity varchar
  enabled boolean
  created_at timestamp
}
Table risk_decisions {
  id bigint [pk]
  transaction_id bigint
  rule_id bigint
  decision varchar
  score decimal
  reason varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table audit_logs {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  actor_type varchar
  action varchar
  entity_type varchar
  entity_id bigint
  metadata json
  created_at timestamp
}
Table webhooks {
  id bigint [pk]
  merchant_id bigint
  event_type varchar
  endpoint varchar
  payload json
  delivery_status varchar
  attempts varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table api_keys {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  merchant_id bigint
  key_prefix varchar
  secret_hash varchar
  scopes varchar
  revoked_at varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table notifications {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  channel varchar
  template_code varchar
  subject varchar
  status varchar
  sent_at timestamp
  created_at timestamp
}
Table support_tickets {
  id bigint [pk]
  user_id bigint
  category varchar
  priority varchar
  status varchar
  subject varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table ticket_messages {
  id bigint [pk]
  ticket_id bigint
  sender_user_id bigint
  body varchar
  created_at timestamp
}
Table reconciliation_runs {
  id bigint [pk]
  account_id bigint
  provider varchar
  run_date timestamp
  status varchar
  matched_count varchar
  unmatched_count varchar
}
Table reconciliation_items {
  id bigint [pk]
  run_id bigint
  transaction_id bigint
  external_reference varchar
  external_amount decimal
  internal_amount decimal
  status varchar
}

import {
  pgTable,
  bigserial,
  bigint,
  varchar,
  timestamp,
  boolean,
  numeric,
  integer,
  jsonb,
} from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'
import { relations } from 'drizzle-orm'
export const users = pgTable('users', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  email: varchar('email', { length: 255 }),
  phone: varchar('phone', { length: 255 }),
  password_hash: varchar('password_hash', { length: 255 }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  country_code: varchar('country_code', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  updated_at: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const user_profiles = pgTable('user_profiles', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  first_name: varchar('first_name', { length: 255 }),
  last_name: varchar('last_name', { length: 255 }),
  date_of_birth: varchar('date_of_birth', { length: 255 }),
  occupation: varchar('occupation', { length: 255 }),
  risk_tier: varchar('risk_tier', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const kyc_profiles = pgTable('kyc_profiles', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  provider: varchar('provider', { length: 255 }),
  external_reference: varchar('external_reference', { length: 255 }),
  verified_at: timestamp('verified_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  reviewed_at: timestamp('reviewed_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const kyc_documents = pgTable('kyc_documents', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  kyc_id: bigint('kyc_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => kyc_profiles.id),
  document_type: varchar('document_type', { length: 255 }),
  document_number_hash: varchar('document_number_hash', { length: 255 }),
  storage_key: varchar('storage_key', { length: 255 }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  expires_at: timestamp('expires_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const user_addresses = pgTable('user_addresses', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  address_type: varchar('address_type', { length: 255 }),
  line1: varchar('line1', { length: 255 }),
  city: varchar('city', { length: 255 }),
  state: varchar('state', { length: 255 }),
  postal_code: varchar('postal_code', { length: 255 }),
  country_code: varchar('country_code', { length: 255 }),
})
export const devices = pgTable('devices', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  device_fingerprint: varchar('device_fingerprint', { length: 255 }),
  platform: varchar('platform', { length: 255 }),
  app_version: varchar('app_version', { length: 255 }),
  trusted: boolean('trusted'),
  last_seen_at: timestamp('last_seen_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const sessions = pgTable('sessions', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  device_id: bigint('device_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => devices.id),
  token_hash: varchar('token_hash', { length: 255 }),
  expires_at: timestamp('expires_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  revoked_at: varchar('revoked_at', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const roles = pgTable('roles', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }),
  description: varchar('description', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const user_roles = pgTable('user_roles', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  role_id: bigint('role_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => roles.id),
  assigned_at: varchar('assigned_at', { length: 255 }),
})
export const accounts = pgTable('accounts', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  account_number: varchar('account_number', { length: 255 }),
  account_type: varchar('account_type', { length: 255 }),
  currency_id: bigint('currency_id', { mode: 'number' }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const account_members = pgTable('account_members', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  account_id: bigint('account_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => accounts.id),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  member_role: varchar('member_role', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const wallets = pgTable('wallets', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  account_id: bigint('account_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => accounts.id),
  wallet_type: varchar('wallet_type', { length: 255 }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const wallet_balances = pgTable('wallet_balances', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  wallet_id: bigint('wallet_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => wallets.id),
  available: numeric('available', { precision: 20, scale: 6 }),
  pending: numeric('pending', { precision: 20, scale: 6 }),
  ledger: numeric('ledger', { precision: 20, scale: 6 }),
  updated_at: timestamp('updated_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const currencies = pgTable('currencies', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  code: varchar('code', { length: 255 }),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }),
  minor_unit: varchar('minor_unit', { length: 255 }),
  is_active: varchar('is_active', { length: 255 }),
})
export const exchange_rates = pgTable('exchange_rates', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  base_currency_id: bigint('base_currency_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => currencies.id),
  quote_currency_id: bigint('quote_currency_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(
    () => currencies.id
  ),
  rate: numeric('rate', { precision: 20, scale: 6 }),
  provider: varchar('provider', { length: 255 }),
  observed_at: timestamp('observed_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const payment_methods = pgTable('payment_methods', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  method_type: varchar('method_type', { length: 255 }),
  provider: varchar('provider', { length: 255 }),
  token_reference: varchar('token_reference', { length: 255 }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const cards = pgTable('cards', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  account_id: bigint('account_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => accounts.id),
  last4: varchar('last4', { length: 255 }),
  brand: varchar('brand', { length: 255 }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  issued_at: timestamp('issued_at', { withTimezone: true }),
  expires_at: timestamp('expires_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const card_transactions = pgTable('card_transactions', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  card_id: bigint('card_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => cards.id),
  merchant_id: bigint('merchant_id', { mode: 'number' }),
  transaction_id: bigint('transaction_id', { mode: 'number' }),
  amount: numeric('amount', { precision: 20, scale: 6 }),
  currency_id: bigint('currency_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => currencies.id),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  posted_at: timestamp('posted_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const merchants = pgTable('merchants', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  legal_name: varchar('legal_name', { length: 255 }),
  display_name: varchar('display_name', { length: 255 }),
  category_code: varchar('category_code', { length: 255 }),
  country_code: varchar('country_code', { length: 255 }),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
  created_at: timestamp('created_at', { withTimezone: true }),
})
export const merchant_accounts = pgTable('merchant_accounts', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  merchant_id: bigint('merchant_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => merchants.id),
  account_id: bigint('account_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => accounts.id),
  settlement_currency_id: bigint('settlement_currency_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(
    () => currencies.id
  ),
  status: varchar('status', { length: 255 }),
})
export const beneficiaries = pgTable('beneficiaries', {
  id: bigserial('id', { mode: 'number' }).primaryKey(),
  user_id: bigint('user_id', { mode: 'number' }).references(() => users.id),
  name: varchar('name', { length: 255 }),
  account_number_hash: varchar('account_number_hash', { length: 255 }),
  bank_code: varchar('bank_code', { length: 255 }),
  country_code: varchar('country_code', { length: 255 }),
